validation.repository_checks: Required validate job passed; current program, registers, catalogue, bundle and workbench checks passed. New fault injections demonstrate supplied contradictions are rejected.

deployment.reason: Repository checker, tests and progress records only; no website source, asset, edition or workflow change. Git delivery verified; no website deployment claimed.

limitations: Same-assistant review, not independent human review.
Offline consistency checks cannot establish that a GitHub run, approval, deployment or live observation actually occurred.
Historical receipts with absent optional fields remain supported; this change rejects supplied contradictions, not every omission.
